 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is a petition filed by the petitioner who has come to approach this Court suffering an apprehension by virtue of an oral information that a preventive detention Order No. 39 DMP dated 26.06.2023 has come to be passed by the District Magistrate, Pulwama thereby directing his preventive detention under the Jammu and Kashmir Public Safety Act, 1978, whereas the petitioner's credentials are clean having been named in one FIR No. 53/2023 dated 10.06.2023 for alleged commission of offences under Section 420 & 120- B Indian Penal Code with the Police Station, Tral.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Public Safety Act, 1978
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The petitioner projects that his personal liberty is being curtailed by respondent Nos. 2 and 3,
whereas the petitioner, being a resident of Village and Tehsil Ajas, District Bandipora and is a well educated person perusing B.V.Sc Degree Programme (final year) from SKAUST-Jammu situated at Chatha, Jammu, having no antecedents so as to be dealt as a prospect for preventive detention.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is placing reliance on order dated 15.07.2020 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in LPA No. 33/2020 and submits that this Court has already protected the petitioner therein by passing the interim order in his favour in the similar facts and circumstances.
Heard.

sentences.text: Issue post-admission notice to the respondents, returnable within four weeks.
Requisite steps for service within two weeks.

Meanwhile, with a view to maintain parity and subject to the objections from other side, the petitioner shall not be subjected to any arrest and custody in the execution of the preventive detention Order No 39 DMP dated 26.06.2023 passed by the District Magistrate, Pulwama till next date of hearing.
